exposure: IBD-PA, prior ileal pouch-anal anastomosis, IBD-Other
cohort: 7472 primiparous individuals aged 15-55 years with IBD and 37,360 matched controls without IBD
finding: Individuals with IBD had a higher risk of Caesarean delivery compared to those without IBD, reflecting guideline-concordant use, while there was no significant difference in the rate of subsequent delivery between the two groups.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in all IBD subgroups (IBD-ileal pouch-anal anastomosis 66.5%, IBD-PA 49.9%, IBD-Other 32.7%) compared to controls without IBD.
